issues.description: Method name inconsistency for the total-students accessor: the task description in problem_statement.md (line 40) asks students to implement a method named getTotalStudents(), while the UML in the same problem_statement.md (line 70) and both the template (TODO comment) and the solution implementation use the name getTotalNumberOfStudents(). This naming contradiction across the narrative, UML, template comments, and solution will confuse students about which method to implement and which name the tests will expect.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the method name across all artifacts. The simplest fix is to update problem_statement.md (task description at line 40) to request getTotalNumberOfStudents() to match the UML, the template TODO, and the solution implementation. Alternatively, rename the method in template and solution to getTotalStudents() and update the UML and any references accordingly. Ensure all task text, UML, template comments, and example/solution code use the exact same identifier so students and automated tests expect the same method name.
